# Community Rule Column 4 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 4 | **Condition:** complete

---

**4:1** a spirit-of humility and patience-of temper, and abundant compassion, and perpetual goodness,

**4:2** and insight, and understanding, and mighty wisdom trusting in all the-deeds-of God,

**4:3** and leaning upon the-abundance-of His covenant-faithfulness; and a spirit-of knowledge in every plan-of action,

**4:4** and zeal for the-judgments-of righteousness, and holy intent with a steadfast purpose,

**4:5** and abundant covenant-faithfulness toward all the-sons-of truth, and glorious purity abhorring all the-idols-of defilement,

**4:6** and walking-in-humility with prudence-in-all-things, and concealing the-truth-of the-mysteries-of knowledge. These are the-counsels-of the-spirit for the-sons-of truth in the-world. And the-visitation-of all who-walk in it shall be:

**4:7** healing and abundance-of peace in length-of days, and fruitfulness-of seed with all blessings-of perpetuity,

**4:8** and eternal joy in the-life-of everlasting-duration, and a crown-of glory with garments-of majesty in light-of perpetuity.

**4:9** But to the-spirit-of deceit belong these: greed-of soul, and slackness-of hands in the-service-of righteousness, and wickedness, and falsehood,

**4:10** and pride, and haughtiness-of heart, and deceitfulness, and cruelty, and great impatience,

**4:11** and much folly, and brazen insolence, and abominable deeds in a spirit-of lewdness, and ways-of defilement in the-service-of impurity,

**4:12** and a blaspheming tongue, and blindness-of eyes, and heaviness-of ears, and stiffness-of neck, and hardness-of heart,

**4:13** so-as-to walk in all the-ways-of darkness and evil cunning. And the-visitation-of all who-walk in it shall be:

**4:14** abundance-of afflictions by the-hand-of all the-angels-of destruction, in the-pit-of everlasting fire, eternal perdition through the-fury-of the-vengeance-of God,

**4:15** perpetual terror and everlasting disgrace, with the-shame-of extinction in the-fire-of the-dark regions. And all their appointed-times for their generations shall be in sorrowful mourning and bitter misery,

**4:16** in dark calamities until their destruction, without remnant or survivor for them.

**4:17** In these two spirits are the-generations-of all the-sons-of man, and in their divisions all the-hosts-of them have an inheritance in their generations.

**4:18** In the-ways-of the-two-spirits they walk. And all the-reward-of their deeds is in their divisions, according-to each-man's inheritance, whether much or little, for all the-periods-of eternity.

**4:19** For God has set them in equal-portions until the-final end, and He has placed everlasting enmity between their divisions.

**4:20** An abomination-to truth are the-deeds-of deceit, and an abomination-to deceit are all the-ways-of truth. And fierce contention is upon all their judgments,

**4:21** for they do-not walk together. But God, in the-mysteries-of His understanding and in the-wisdom-of His glory, has set an appointed-end for the-existence-of injustice,

**4:22** and at the-time-of the-visitation He will destroy it forever. And then the-truth-of the-world shall come-forth perpetually, for it has wallowed in the-ways-of wickedness

**4:23** during the-dominion-of injustice until the-appointed-time-of the-decreed judgment. And then God will purify by His truth all the-deeds-of a man,

**4:24** and He will refine for Himself the-frame-of man, to consume every spirit-of injustice from the-midst-of his flesh,

**4:25** and to cleanse him by a holy spirit from all wicked deeds. And He will sprinkle upon him a spirit-of truth like waters-of-purification,

**4:26** to cleanse him from all the-abominations-of falsehood and from being-defiled by a spirit-of impurity, so-as-to instruct the-upright-ones in the-knowledge-of the-Most-High and the-wisdom-of the-sons-of heaven, to make-wise the-perfect-of way. For God has chosen them for an everlasting covenant, and to them belongs all the-glory-of Adam.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Hebrew text of 1QS Column 4 (Cave 1, complete). Hyphenated construct chains preserve Hebrew bound forms. "Covenant-faithfulness" renders hesed. "Sons of man" preserves bene 'ish. "Glory of Adam" (kevod 'Adam) at 4:26 is a distinctive Qumran eschatological phrase. "Frame of man" (yetser) preserved literally at 4:24.*
